description: This file defines a class 'NumberConverters' that provides various number conversion utilities and registers multiple converter instances for different number types within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: NumberConverters
classes.description: Main class implementing ConverterLoader, responsible for loading and registering number conversion utilities.
